findings.description: The evidence_class vocabulary is not pinned as one closed set: F002 names terminal_transcript and contract_test, while F003 emits cli_transcript and contract_check, so captured agent evidence can fail the checker and close gate.

F004 adds required_data_sources to journeys but does not specify where evidence records structured data_source, availability, provenance, and capability_unavailable assertions, making keyed cross-surface comparison underspecified.
F001 allows consumer=both, but F005 only describes enforcement for journeys declaring consumer in {human, agent}, leaving the required per-family close-time proof for both ambiguous.
The required_evidence_classes API collapses surface, consumer, and claim kind even though mutation and qualitative claims are not surface classes and may share a surface with read-only claims.

The contract says real-or-honestly-degraded data can prove readiness and F004 says honest degradation passes, but F005 requires at least one real non-seeded end-to-end journey, so degraded close behavior is unresolved.
F005 relies on explicit non-goal deferral and operator disposition to allow close, but the plan does not define the structured fields or validation needed to distinguish them from ordinary prose.
F003 says typed-skip may use data_provenance=degraded or a skip marker, but F001 only permits seeded, real, or degraded, so the skip representation could violate the schema.
